Commander’s field manual

The game uses its original interface and campaign progression.

  • Left click a unit or building to select it. Choose an action in the command panel, then click its destination or target.
  • Right click cancels a target command. Move the pointer to a map edge, or use the original direction keys, to scroll.
  • Select the Construction Yard to build. Place concrete on rock before placing most structures.
  • Refineries turn harvested spice into credits. Protect your harvesters and keep your Windtraps running.
  • Press F2 or select Options to save, load, adjust game speed or return to the menu. F1 opens the Mentat.
  • Use Space or a mouse click to advance the Mentat’s text, then select Proceed.
  • Cutscenes can be skipped with a key or mouse button where the original sequence allows it.

Save using the original menu, then use Saved missions above the screen to export a backup. Imported native saves appear in the original Load Game menu.

Saved missions

Export a native save, or import an original SAVE000.DAT or browser _save000.dat file. Imports use the next free slot.
